description: This Java source file defines a custom exception class PolicyIdMissingException used in the Eclipse Ditto project. It indicates that a policy ID is missing when attempting to perform certain operations (update or create) on a Thing object, especially when schema versions require a policy ID. The class extends DittoRuntimeException and provides static factory methods for different scenarios, along with a builder pattern for creation.

classes.name: PolicyIdMissingException
classes.description: Custom exception indicating a missing policy ID for a Thing operation, providing static methods for construction based on operation type or JSON input, and supporting schema versioning.

methods.name: fromThingIdOnUpdate
methods.description: Creates an exception instance for update operations on a Thing with a specific ID, using headers to derive schema version.

methods.name: fromThingIdOnCreate
methods.description: Creates an exception instance for create operations on a Thing with a specific ID, using headers to derive schema version.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates an instance of the exception from a JSON object and headers, parsing details accordingly.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
